bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM LATE TONIGHT THROUGH SUNDAY AFTERNOON... Combined seas 3 or 5 ft building to 8 to 10 ft tonight. Bar conditions moderate becoming rough at times. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 400 PM Saturday, and 415 AM and 445 PM Sunday. The Sunday afternoon ebb will be very strong.
bar.seas: 3 or 5 ft building to 8 to 10 ft tonight
bar.ebb: afternoon ebb will be very strong
